d:
Relive the closest calls from Season 1 as storm chasers put themselves in the path of extreme weather. From powerful tornadoes to violent winds and flying debris, these are the moments when chasing the storm gets a little too close for comfort.

About In the Eye of the Storm Chasers:
Storm chasers and certified weather spotters self-shoot their encounters with nature at its most extreme, and help save lives when disaster strikes.
